holiday_no_draws_2025.note: The official Nagaland State Lotteries rule states draws occur 362 days per year and excludes 26 January, 15 August and 2 October. The 2025 Nagaland Gazette lists those dates as Republic Day, Independence Day and Dussehra/Gandhi Jayanti holidays. October archive explicitly marks 2 October Holiday. This is positive rule/calendar evidence, not an inference from broken links.
